Subject: New supplier activation - bank details and PO process

Hi Olga,

We are ready to add Redwood Inference as an approved payee in our finance system. To finish the onboarding we need: a signed vendor packet, W9, proof of bank (letter or voided check), and confirmation of the remit identifier you expect to see on invoices so our AP system can attach the correct PO automatically.

Two quick questions:
- Do you prefer ACH (CCD) or ACH+Wire as your primary receiving rail?
- Is there a specific remit token or suffix we should include on the PO/invoice (for example: RDW-<account>) so remittance automation maps correctly?

We're aiming to schedule the first payment run for the week of Mar 18 if everything's in place. I attached our onboarding checklist (referenced below) and will upload bank evidence after our team generates it.

Thanks,

- Remit token: please use the PO suffix format RDW#<PO_NUMBER> on the invoice remittance line. Our procurement flow will parse that suffix and connect it with the PO in our system. Example: RDW#789312.

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier activation - bank details and PO process

Thanks for looping us in — quick procurement note.

We can support the RDW#<PO_NUMBER> suffix in our automated PO matching, but two things to confirm so we don't introduce edge cases into the ingestion job:
1) Please ensure PO numbers are numeric only (no dashes or letters inside the <PO_NUMBER> portion). If ClearArc's PO format includes letters, ask them to provide a numeric-only alias for the suffix.
2) For cases where invoices list multiple POs, our importer expects a comma-separated RDW# list on the remittance line (e.g., RDW#12345,RDW#12346). If their billing system adds spaces, the parser will still trim them, but we prefer no embedded text.

I'm cc'ing Marissa because Finance needs the bank-letter proof to schedule the ACH test. Marissa — once we have ClearArc's bank evidence, can you kick off the staging micro-deposit and put the vendor in the Mar 18 payment cohort pending success? If there are any KYC flags I should be aware of, flag here.

Jordan Blake
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
